Jazak Allah Question: Assalam Alaikum, I would like to know the meanings of these names ZAHAAN (for Boy, I think it should be INTELLIGENT) KASHAF (for girl, I think it should be MOJIZA) Kindly assist in this regard. Jazak Allah Answer ID: 16016 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1470/1469=M=1430) Zahhan ( ذھان ) means very intelligent, a person of good memory, while Kashf means to open, disclose etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
